    scanf("%lld%lld%lld", &x, &y, &n);

    if (y <= n) {
        long long g = __gcd(x, y);
        printf("%lld/%lld", x / g, y / g);
        return 0;

    vector<Cand> candidates;
    if (n > 0) candidates.reserve((size_t)n);

    for (long long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        long long j = (long long)((__int128)i * x / y);

        __int128 d1 = Abs128((__int128)i * x - (__int128)j * y);
        __int128 d2 = Abs128((__int128)i * x - (__int128)(j + 1) * y);
        if (d1 > d2) ++j;

        __int128 err = Abs128((__int128)i * x - (__int128)j * y);
        candidates.push_back({j, i, err});

    if (candidates.empty()) {
        printf("-1/0");

    auto best = min_element(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(),
        [](const Cand& a, const Cand& b) {
            __int128 lhs = a.err * b.den;
            __int128 rhs = b.err * a.den;
            if (lhs != rhs) return lhs < rhs;
            return a.den < b.den;
        });

    printf("%lld/%lld", best->num, best->den);
